stories.title: Send 4 documents to Deepak via Google eSignature
stories.description: Convert HTML docs to PDF, upload to Google Drive, add eSignature fields, send to Deepak. AVS (no sign), Treatment Plan (sign), SB 577 (sign), Recording Consent (sign).
stories.acceptance: All 4 docs sent. SB 577 + AoS signed before Session 2. Signed copies in MinIO + Google Drive.

stories.title: Deliver Session 2 (The Installation Session)
stories.description: 331-paragraph installation session. 10 PHS with ideomotor checks. Conference feedback integrated (reverse induction, fish imagery, miniature golf, bedtime call).
stories.acceptance: Session delivered via Zoom. PHS re-entry timed. SOAP notes written. AVS generated. Tracker data collected post-session.

stories.title: Offer 5-min bedtime Zoom calls (first week post-S2)
stories.description: Per conference feedback: 5-min Zoom at 10:45 PM, guide settling + Depth Dial in real sleep environment. Optional, client chooses nights.
stories.acceptance: At least 2 bedtime calls completed. Client reports onset improvement.

stories.title: Collect and review Session 2 feedback + tracker data
stories.description: Collect Deepak's post-S2 tracker data (Deep+REM %, light %, onset, depth score). Update drift tracking. Determine S3 path.
stories.acceptance: Data reviewed. Drift tracking updated. S3 path selected (on track / partial / regression).

stories.title: Deliver Session 3 (Maintenance + Overactive Mind)
stories.description: 177-paragraph session. Depth Anchor Chain, Notebook Technique, Processing Vault, Train Technique, Auto-Pilot. Adapted from HW Maintenance Insomnia + Pre-Sleep Overthinking.
stories.acceptance: Session delivered. New techniques installed. Homework updated. SOAP + AVS generated.

stories.title: Deliver Session 4 (Independence Pivot)
stories.description: 148-paragraph session. Self-hypnosis teach (7-step), Natural Pharmacy, Childhood Sleep Memory, Autonomous System. Client runs protocol independently after this.
stories.acceptance: Client demonstrates self-hypnosis in session. Confidence score 7+/10. Independence achieved.

stories.title: Deliver Session 5 (Fine-Tuning, 3 paths)
stories.description: 141-paragraph session. Path A (on track): stress inoculation. Path B (partial): targeted gap fix. Path C (regression): simplified reinstall.
stories.acceptance: Path selected based on 2-week data. Targeted intervention delivered. Graduation readiness assessed.

stories.title: Build Session 6 script (Sleep Temple graduation)
stories.description: Build graduation script using HW Sleep Temples Metaphor. Capstone visualization. Relapse prevention. Turbo mode. Data graph + ceremony card + recording.
stories.acceptance: Script written. Graduation deliverables prepared (graph, card, recording, handbook).

stories.title: Build Personalized Graduation Handbook
stories.description: Comprehensive lifetime guide for Deepak. All techniques, ceremony, self-hypnosis, troubleshooting. Printed + PDF.
stories.acceptance: Handbook generated as printable HTML/PDF. Stored in MinIO. Given to client at graduation.

stories.title: Record Session 2 therapy portion as audio
stories.description: Record progressive relaxation + therapeutic suggestion section of S2 as MP3 for client bedtime playback.
stories.acceptance: Audio file saved to MinIO DS-001/recordings/. Client can download via portal or PocketSuite.

stories.title: Documents tab on /client-journey (MinIO file browser)
stories.description: Browse MinIO client-documents bucket. Preview images, download PDFs, upload new files. Per-client folder view.
stories.acceptance: Can view tracker screenshots, download AVS PDFs, upload new client artifacts from the portal.

stories.title: More case categories (Anxiety, Confidence, Habits, Pain, Relationships)
stories.description: 5 new case categories with at least 1 case each. Full intake dialogue, session plan, scripts, clinical notes.
stories.acceptance: 5 new cases visible on /cases page with full scripts and session plans.

stories.title: Inferred drill scripts (7 remaining)
stories.description: Add script field to: inferred_rapport, inferred_induction, inferred_deepening, inferred_suggestions, inferred_metaphor, overload_7pm2, ericksonian_confusion.
stories.acceptance: All 47 drills have script field. 47/47 coverage.

stories.title: PDF workbook export from Case Journal
stories.description: Generate complete PDF workbook from case journal data — all entries, reasoning, research, comms, time. For HMI submission.
stories.acceptance: Click 'Generate Workbook' → PDF in MinIO with all journal sections formatted for print.

stories.title: Bootstrap client-portal Next.js app (port 3071)
stories.description: Create apps/client-portal/ with Next.js 14 App Router. Separate from academy-web. Dark theme, mobile-responsive.
stories.acceptance: App runs on port 3071. Login page renders. Shared backend API accessible.

stories.title: Client auth (separate from therapist)
stories.description: Client registration via invite link. JWT with role='client'. Row-level security — clients see ONLY their journey_id data.
stories.acceptance: Client can register with invite code, login, see only their data. Cannot access other clients or therapist tools.

stories.title: Client dashboard page
stories.description: Upcoming sessions, homework status, sleep scores, next appointment CTA.
stories.acceptance: Client sees their session history, current homework, next session date, and progress chart.

stories.title: Session history + AVS downloads
stories.description: Client can view past sessions and download AVS PDFs from MinIO via pre-signed URLs.
stories.acceptance: Client can see all their sessions and download any AVS document.

stories.title: Post-session feedback form
stories.description: Structured feedback: sleep quality (1-10), onset estimate, night-wakes, dream journal, homework compliance checkboxes, free-text.
stories.acceptance: Client submits feedback. Data saved to client_sessions. Therapist sees it on client-journey page.

stories.title: HIPAA-compliant messaging
stories.description: Threaded messaging between client and therapist. Encrypted at rest. Read receipts. Replaces WhatsApp.
stories.acceptance: Client and therapist can exchange messages. No PHI on WhatsApp. All messages logged to communication_log.

stories.title: Homework tracking page
stories.description: Daily checklist: 4-7-8 breathing, tension-release, settling practice, dream journal, screen cutoff, time-boxing.
stories.acceptance: Client checks off daily homework. Therapist sees compliance rate per week.

stories.title: Sleep tracker data upload
stories.description: Client uploads tracker screenshots or CSV exports. Stored in MinIO. Viewable by therapist.
stories.acceptance: Client can upload files. Files appear in MinIO DS-001/tracker-data/. Therapist can view on client-journey documents tab.

stories.title: Documents page (consent forms, recordings, handbook)
stories.description: Client can view and download their documents from MinIO: AVS, consent forms, recordings, handbook.
stories.acceptance: Client sees all their documents with download links.

stories.title: PWA manifest + service worker
stories.description: Make client portal installable on phone. Offline homework checklist. Push notifications for ceremony reminders.
stories.acceptance: Client can install portal on phone home screen. Homework works offline. Push notifications received.

stories.title: E-signature integration (in-portal consent signing)
stories.description: Client can sign SB 577, AoS, recording consent directly in the portal without Google/DocuSign.
stories.acceptance: Consent forms signable in-browser. Signed copies stored in MinIO consent/ folder.

stories.title: API gateway for client portal
stories.description: NGINX reverse proxy: portal.vrishihypno.com → client-portal :3071, api.vrishihypno.com → progress-svc :8603.
stories.acceptance: Portal accessible via HTTPS at portal.vrishihypno.com. API calls route correctly.

stories.title: Client onboarding flow (intake → consent → portal invite)
stories.description: Public intake form → therapist review → approve → auto-create journey + send portal invite email with registration link.
stories.acceptance: End-to-end flow from vrishihypno.com intake to client logged into portal.

stories.title: DNS + SSL for portal subdomain
stories.description: Configure portal.vrishihypno.com DNS. SSL certificate via Let's Encrypt or Cloudflare.
stories.acceptance: HTTPS working at portal.vrishihypno.com with valid SSL.

stories.title: Booking → portal auto-link (Calendly/PocketSuite webhook)
stories.description: When client books via Calendly or PocketSuite, auto-create client_journeys record and send portal invite.
stories.acceptance: Booking confirmed → journey created → invite email sent → client can login to portal.

stories.title: HIPAA BAA with hosting provider
stories.description: Sign Business Associate Agreement with AWS/hosting provider for HIPAA-compliant PHI storage.
stories.acceptance: BAA signed and on file. Hosting environment meets HIPAA technical safeguards.

stories.title: PWA vs React Native decision
stories.description: Evaluate PWA (from E3-S10) vs React Native for iOS/Android. Consider: push notifications, offline, biometric auth, app store presence.
stories.acceptance: Decision documented with pros/cons. Architecture chosen.

stories.title: iOS + Android deployment
stories.description: Deploy client portal as native app (if React Native) or PWA to app stores.
stories.acceptance: App installable from App Store and Google Play (or PWA installable from browser).

stories.title: Biometric auth (Face ID / fingerprint)
stories.description: Client can login with biometrics on mobile. Secure token storage.
stories.acceptance: Biometric login works on iOS + Android. Fallback to password.

stories.title: AWS deployment (App Runner + ECR)
stories.description: Deploy all services to AWS. Terraform IaC. ECR for images. App Runner for compute. SSM for secrets.
stories.acceptance: All services running on AWS. HTTPS. Automated deployments from GitHub.

stories.title: Production database backups
stories.description: Automated daily PostgreSQL backups. WAL archiving. Point-in-time recovery capability.
stories.acceptance: Daily backups running. Verified restore tested. 30-day retention.

stories.title: Rotate ElevenLabs API key
stories.description: Current key compromised (in tts_service.py:482). Generate new key, update .env, verify TTS still works.
stories.acceptance: New key active. Old key revoked. TTS service healthy.

stories.title: HIPAA-compliant hosting environment
stories.description: Encryption at rest for PostgreSQL + MinIO. VPC isolation. Access logging. CloudTrail/audit.
stories.acceptance: All PHI encrypted at rest and in transit. Audit logs enabled. BAA signed.
